title: The web app plays on the session's beat: start on the bar, tempo changes, stop, edits
description:
As a performer using the web app, I want play to land on the session's beat, tempo changes to be followed and the DAW's stop to stop the page, so that the browser works beside the DAW like `apricity play --link`.

Spec file: `features/link/browser.feature`. Runners: node tests on `web/src/audio/link-clock.ts` and the wasm mixer (`web/test/link-clock.test.ts`, `web/test/wasm.test.mjs`) against a scripted clock stream; checked by hand in browsers (M3 manual task). "The browser tolerance" is in `design/link.md`.

```gherkin
Feature: The web app plays in a Link session

  Background:
    Given the web app was opened from apricity serve --link
    And a Link session at 124 BPM with 1 other peer, playing, sharing start/stop

  Scenario: Start on the next bar line
    When I turn Link on and press play on a score at 100 BPM
    Then the score plays at 124 BPM
    And bar 1 sounds on the session's next bar line within the browser tolerance

  Scenario: The session's tempo changes mid-bar
    When the other peer changes the tempo to 98 BPM in the middle of a bar
    Then the clicks stay on the session's beats within the browser tolerance
    And the render workers re-warp the score for 98 BPM and it lands on a bar line

  Scenario: The DAW stops and starts
    When the other peer stops
    Then the web app falls silent at the same moment, within the browser tolerance
    When it starts again
    Then bar 1 sounds on the session's first beat

  Scenario: Edits land on the session's bar lines
    When I edit the score while it plays
    Then the change lands on the session's next bar line

  Scenario: Turning Link off
    When I turn Link off while playing
    Then the web app keeps playing at the session's last tempo on its own clock
```
